design: Read-aloud clips (spec 7.1): the speaker reads source_text; reference_en is exact by construction. References for non-English clips are faithful (literal-leaning) translations so chrF is meaningful. Slices: en, ar, fr, en-ar, en-fr, mixed.

clips.source_text: I have a meeting with Julia on Thursday at three thirty, so I need to leave the office by two forty-five at the latest. Traffic on King Fahd Road is unpredictable.
clips.reference_en: I have a meeting with Julia on Thursday at three thirty, so I need to leave the office by two forty-five at the latest. Traffic on King Fahd Road is unpredictable.

clips.source_text: The new server arrived yesterday. It has two terabytes of memory and twelve cores, which should be enough for the training runs we planned this quarter.
clips.reference_en: The new server arrived yesterday. It has two terabytes of memory and twelve cores, which should be enough for the training runs we planned this quarter.

clips.source_text: Honestly, I think the biggest problem isn't the model itself, it's the data. We have plenty of audio but almost nothing with clean references.
clips.reference_en: Honestly, I think the biggest problem isn't the model itself, it's the data. We have plenty of audio but almost nothing with clean references.

clips.source_text: My flight lands at eleven twenty in the evening. Don't pick me up, I'll take a taxi to the hotel and meet you in the morning.
clips.reference_en: My flight lands at eleven twenty in the evening. Don't pick me up, I'll take a taxi to the hotel and meet you in the morning.

clips.source_text: She ordered three coffees, one tea, and a bottle of water. The total came to seventy-five riyals, which honestly seems a bit expensive for five drinks.
clips.reference_en: She ordered three coffees, one tea, and a bottle of water. The total came to seventy-five riyals, which honestly seems a bit expensive for five drinks.

clips.source_text: Remember to back up your laptop before the trip. Last time the update failed and I lost two weeks of work, and I don't want that happening to you.
clips.reference_en: Remember to back up your laptop before the trip. Last time the update failed and I lost two weeks of work, and I don't want that happening to you.

clips.source_text: The apartment is on the fifth floor, second door on the left. The code for the building is four five seven nine, and the landlord's name is Mr. Khalid.
clips.reference_en: The apartment is on the fifth floor, second door on the left. The code for the building is four five seven nine, and the landlord's name is Mr. Khalid.

clips.source_text: We finished the report two days early, so the manager gave the team Friday off. It was the first real break we've had since the project started in January.
clips.reference_en: We finished the report two days early, so the manager gave the team Friday off. It was the first real break we've had since the project started in January.

clips.source_text: I usually go running before sunrise, around five fifteen. In summer that's the only time the weather cooperates, otherwise it's thirty-eight degrees by nine in the morning.
clips.reference_en: I usually go running before sunrise, around five fifteen. In summer that's the only time the weather cooperates, otherwise it's thirty-eight degrees by nine in the morning.

clips.source_text: The doctor said the results look normal, but I should drink more water and sleep at least seven hours a night. Easier said than done with the baby waking up.
clips.reference_en: The doctor said the results look normal, but I should drink more water and sleep at least seven hours a night. Easier said than done with the baby waking up.

clips.source_text: This recipe needs two cups of rice, one onion, and about four hundred grams of chicken. Let it cook for twenty minutes and don't lift the lid.
clips.reference_en: This recipe needs two cups of rice, one onion, and about four hundred grams of chicken. Let it cook for twenty minutes and don't lift the lid.

clips.source_text: The conference tickets sold out in under an hour. Next year I'm setting an alarm the minute they go on sale, because I refuse to watch the streams again.
clips.reference_en: The conference tickets sold out in under an hour. Next year I'm setting an alarm the minute they go on sale, because I refuse to watch the streams again.

clips.source_text: عندي اجتماع مع مدير المشروع يوم الأربعاء الساعة العشر صباحاً، وموعد الطبيب بعده بساعتين فلا أستطيع تأجيل أي منهما.
clips.reference_en: I have a meeting with the project manager on Wednesday at ten in the morning, and my doctor's appointment is two hours after it, so I can't postpone either one.

clips.source_text: اشتريت لابتوب جديد بألف وخمسمائة ريال، فيه ذاكرة سعة ستة عشر جيجابايت وشاشة ممتازة للتصميم.
clips.reference_en: I bought a new laptop for one thousand five hundred riyals, it has sixteen gigabytes of memory and an excellent screen for design.

clips.source_text: الجامعة أعلنت أن التسجيل للفصل الصيفي يبدأ الأحد القادم، والقبول في بعض التخصصات تنافسي جداً.
clips.reference_en: The university announced that registration for the summer semester starts next Sunday, and admission to some majors is very competitive.

clips.source_text: والدي يسأل عنك دائماً. اتصل به نهاية هذا الأسبوع لو تقدر، لأنه يريد مشاركتك في موضوع البيت الجديد.
clips.reference_en: My father asks about you all the time. Call him this weekend if you can, because he wants to discuss the new house matter with you.

clips.source_text: الحركة في الرياض صباحاً لا تحتمل، أخرج من البيت قبل السادسة والنصف وإلا وصلت متأخراً ساعة كاملة.
clips.reference_en: The traffic in Riyadh in the morning is unbearable, I leave the house before six thirty or I arrive a full hour late.

clips.source_text: قرأت مقالاً مثيراً عن الذكاء الاصطناعي في الطب، يقول إن التشخيص المبكر صار أدق بثلاثين بالمئة.
clips.reference_en: I read an exciting article about artificial intelligence in medicine, it says early diagnosis has become thirty percent more accurate.

clips.source_text: المطعم الجديد في حي الملقا سعره معقول والطعام لذيذ، لكن الانتظار يوم الجمعة يصل إلى أربعين دقيقة.
clips.reference_en: The new restaurant in Al Malqa district is reasonably priced and the food is delicious, but the wait on Friday reaches forty minutes.

clips.source_text: أخي الصغير نجح في اختبار القيادة من المحاولة الأولى، والآن يريد سيارة والأب يقول بعد التخرج.
clips.reference_en: My little brother passed the driving test on the first try, and now he wants a car, and my father says after graduation.

clips.source_text: درجة الحرارة اليوم أربعون درجة، والرطوبة عالية جداً، لذلك أفضل البقاء في البيت حتى المغرب.
clips.reference_en: The temperature today is forty degrees, and the humidity is very high, so I prefer to stay home until sunset.

clips.source_text: نحتاج موافقة الوزارة قبل نهاية الشهر، والوثائق الناقصة ثلاث فقط: صورة الهوية، وشهادة الميلاد، وعرضاً مالياً.
clips.reference_en: We need the ministry's approval before the end of the month, and only three documents are missing: a copy of the ID, the birth certificate, and a financial proposal.

clips.source_text: جدول الرحلة تغير مرتين هذا الأسبوع، والآن الإقلاع الساعة الواحدة بعد منتصف الليل بدل التاسعة مساءً.
clips.reference_en: The flight schedule changed twice this week, and now departure is at one after midnight instead of nine in the evening.

clips.source_text: الحفلة كانت رائعة، حضر أكثر من مئتي شخص، وقدم الفريق عرضاً قصيراً عن إنجازات السنة.
clips.reference_en: The party was wonderful, more than two hundred people attended, and the team presented a short show about the year's achievements.

clips.source_text: Je vais chez le médecin mardi à quatorze heures trente. C'est la première fois que je vais dans ce nouveau cabinet près de la gare.
clips.reference_en: I'm going to the doctor on Tuesday at two thirty in the afternoon. It's the first time I'm going to this new clinic near the station.

clips.source_text: Le train pour Lyon part à huit heures dix. Il faut acheter les billets en ligne, sinon c'est beaucoup plus cher.
clips.reference_en: The train to Lyon leaves at eight ten. You have to buy the tickets online, otherwise it's much more expensive.

clips.source_text: Mon frère habite à Montréal depuis trois ans. Il dit que l'hiver est difficile, mais le travail est très intéressant.
clips.reference_en: My brother has lived in Montreal for three years. He says the winter is difficult, but the work is very interesting.

clips.source_text: Nous avons réservé une table pour six personnes au restaurant italien, samedi soir à vingt heures.
clips.reference_en: We reserved a table for six people at the Italian restaurant, Saturday evening at eight.

clips.source_text: Le nouveau téléphone coûte neuf cents euros, donc j'attends les soldes de janvier pour l'acheter.
clips.reference_en: The new phone costs nine hundred euros, so I'm waiting for the January sales to buy it.

clips.source_text: Il faut du pain, du fromage, deux kilos de tomates et une bouteille d'huile d'olive pour la recette de ce soir.
clips.reference_en: We need bread, cheese, two kilos of tomatoes, and a bottle of olive oil for tonight's recipe.

clips.source_text: La réunion est reportée à jeudi prochain parce que la directrice est en voyage d'affaires à Paris.
clips.reference_en: The meeting is postponed to next Thursday because the director is on a business trip to Paris.

clips.source_text: J'ai terminé le livre en trois jours. L'histoire est triste mais très belle, surtout la fin.
clips.reference_en: I finished the book in three days. The story is sad but very beautiful, especially the ending.

clips.source_text: Le musée est fermé le lundi. On peut y aller mercredi matin, l'entrée est gratuite pour les étudiants.
clips.reference_en: The museum is closed on Mondays. We can go Wednesday morning, entrance is free for students.

clips.source_text: Mon vol retour est annulé à cause de la grève. La compagnie propose un autre avion demain à onze heures.
clips.reference_en: My return flight is cancelled because of the strike. The airline is offering another plane tomorrow at eleven.

clips.source_text: The deadline is next Sunday يعني ما فيه وقت, I still have three chapters to review قبل ما أسلم التقرير النهائي.
clips.reference_en: The deadline is next Sunday, meaning there's no time, I still have three chapters to review before I submit the final report.

clips.source_text: مديري الجديد very supportive, he said خذ وقتك with the migration plan بس لا تتأخر أكثر من أسبوع.
clips.reference_en: My new manager is very supportive, he said take your time with the migration plan, but don't be more than a week late.

clips.source_text: We booked the flight through Dubai, الوصول الساعة خمسة الصبح, so لا تنام قبل ما توصل الفندق.
clips.reference_en: We booked the flight through Dubai, arriving at five in the morning, so don't sleep before you get to the hotel.

clips.source_text: الجوال الجديد فيه تحديث كبير للكاميرا, honestly the photos look amazing خصوصاً في الليل.
clips.reference_en: The new phone has a big camera update, honestly the photos look amazing, especially at night.

clips.source_text: I called the bank twice اليوم, they said البطاقة الجديدة تصل خلال خمسة أيام عمل.
clips.reference_en: I called the bank twice today, they said the new card arrives within five business days.

clips.source_text: أمي تسأل عنك كل يوم. Send her a message لو تقدر, she wants to know متى بتزورنا في العيد.
clips.reference_en: My mother asks about you every day. Send her a message if you can, she wants to know when you'll visit us for Eid.

clips.source_text: The interview went well أعتقد, but the salary أقل من اللي كنت أتوقع باثنين وعشرين بالمئة.
clips.reference_en: The interview went well I think, but the salary is twenty-two percent lower than what I was expecting.

clips.source_text: خالد says the new office في الدور الثالث, bigger than the old one وأرحم للجرافيك لأن الشاشات جديدة.
clips.reference_en: Khalid says the new office is on the third floor, bigger than the old one and better for graphics because the monitors are new.

clips.source_text: I finished the Arabic course! صرت أعرف أكتب رسائل شغل بدون مساعدة, which is a huge step بالنسبة لي.
clips.reference_en: I finished the Arabic course! I can now write work messages without help, which is a huge step for me.

clips.source_text: السيارة تحتاج صيانة عند الأربعين ألف كيلومتر, the dealer quoted me ألف ومئتين ريال for the full service.
clips.reference_en: The car needs maintenance at forty thousand kilometers, the dealer quoted me one thousand two hundred riyals for the full service.

clips.source_text: Sorry I'm late, الازدحام على جسر الملك فهد كان غير طبيعي. It took me ساعة وربع for what's usually عشرين دقيقة.
clips.reference_en: Sorry I'm late, the traffic on King Fahd Bridge was abnormal. It took me an hour and a quarter for what's usually twenty minutes.

clips.source_text: الآن الفرق واضح. Before the update كان التطبيق يعلق كل يوم, now it opens in أقل من ثانيتين.
clips.reference_en: Now the difference is clear. Before the update the app froze every day, now it opens in less than two seconds.

clips.source_text: My cousin's wedding كان الشهر الماضي, أكثر من ثلاثمئة مدعو, and the food كان تنويع بين عربي وإيطالي.
clips.reference_en: My cousin's wedding was last month, more than three hundred guests, and the food was a mix of Arabic and Italian.

clips.source_text: الدكتور قال النتيجة طبيعية الحمد لله, just drink more water وتمرن ثلاث مرات في الأسبوع على الأقل.
clips.reference_en: The doctor said the result is normal thank God, just drink more water and exercise at least three times a week.

clips.source_text: The client approved the design بالاتفاق, بس طلبوا تعديلين صغيرين على الألوان before we go live الأحد.
clips.reference_en: The client approved the design unanimously, but they asked for two small changes to the colors before we go live on Sunday.

clips.source_text: The bakery near the office, la pâtisserie de Marie, opens at six, et leur pain au chocolat est incroyable honestly.
clips.reference_en: The bakery near the office, Marie's pastry shop, opens at six, and their pain au chocolat is incredible honestly.

clips.source_text: Je dois renouveler mon passeport before September, parce que le voyage à Genève is confirmed for the twelfth.
clips.reference_en: I have to renew my passport before September, because the trip to Geneva is confirmed for the twelfth.

clips.source_text: La réunion a duré deux heures. We lost the wifi au milieu de la présentation, c'était embarrassant.
clips.reference_en: The meeting lasted two hours. We lost the wifi in the middle of the presentation, it was embarrassing.

clips.source_text: My French is getting better. Hier j'ai passé un appel technique entier without switching to English, juste deux mots peut-être.
clips.reference_en: My French is getting better. Yesterday I handled an entire technical call without switching to English, just two words maybe.

clips.source_text: Le nouveau collègue from Lyon parle un peu arabe aussi, il a appris à Beyrouth pendant six mois.
clips.reference_en: The new colleague from Lyon also speaks a little Arabic, he learned it in Beirut for six months.

clips.source_text: The train was late again, en retard de vingt minutes, so j'ai raté la correspondance et je suis arrivé à midi moins le quart.
clips.reference_en: The train was late again, twenty minutes late, so I missed the connection and I arrived at quarter to noon.

clips.source_text: On doit réserver le restaurant avant vendredi. Table for eight, avec le menu végétarien pour deux personnes.
clips.reference_en: We have to book the restaurant before Friday. Table for eight, with the vegetarian menu for two people.

clips.source_text: الاجتماع مع l'équipe de Paris is tomorrow, ونفس اليوم عندي موعد مع الحلاق at four, so أعتمد عليك تاخذ الأولاد من المدرسة.
clips.reference_en: The meeting with the Paris team is tomorrow, and the same day I have a barber appointment at four, so I'm counting on you to pick up the kids from school.

clips.source_text: Bonjour! صباح الخير. The demo starts dans dix minutes, كل شيء جاهز؟
clips.reference_en: Hello! Good morning. The demo starts in ten minutes, is everything ready?

clips.source_text: J'ai commandé le câble from Amazon الأحد الماضي, واليوم وصل أخيراً, mais il est trop court d'un mètre.
clips.reference_en: I ordered the cable from Amazon last Sunday, and it finally arrived today, but it's one meter too short.

clips.source_text: الترقية صارت في janvier, والنتيجة were better than expected بفارق خمسة عشر بالمئة.
clips.reference_en: The upgrade happened in January, and the results were better than expected by fifteen percent.

clips.source_text: Notre voisin, أبو خالد, fixed my car pendant le week-end et il a refusé l'argent, so I baked him a cake أمس.
clips.reference_en: Our neighbor, Abu Khalid, fixed my car during the weekend and he refused the money, so I baked him a cake yesterday.

clips.source_text: The certificate expires في نهاية الشهر. Renewal fees are quatre-vingt dollars, والمعاملة تاخذ ثلاث أيام عمل.
clips.reference_en: The certificate expires at the end of the month. Renewal fees are eighty dollars, and the process takes three business days.
